steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Power: the ability to make others do what you want. Lukes identified three dimensions: decision-making, agenda-setting, and ideological power. | Key Fact: Weber's three types of authority: Traditional (custom - monarchy), Charismatic (personal qualities - MLK), Rational-legal (rules and laws - elected officials). Most modern authority is rational-legal. | Key Fact: The state: institutions that govern (government, parliament, police, courts). Marxists: the state serves ruling class interests. Functionalists: the state serves collective interests. Pluralists: the state balances competing interests. | Key Fact: Power elites: Mills argued power is concentrated in a small group of corporate leaders, military chiefs and politicians.
